subject.title: fix(media): map sandbox media with active workdir

question: Should maintainers use this PR as the candidate fix for the OpenShell sandbox media mismatch once real behavior proof is added, or continue with a sibling branch?
rationale: Two open candidate PRs target the same canonical bug, and automation cannot decide branch ownership or waive the external real-behavior proof gate.

options.title: Use this PR after proof
options.body: Keep this PR as the candidate because the source shape is complete and ask the contributor for redacted OpenShell/Gateway media-transfer proof before merge.

options.title: Use the sibling PR
options.body: Move review focus to the sibling if maintainers prefer that branch’s authorship or proof path, then close this PR after linking the chosen candidate.

options.title: Pause both candidates
options.body: Hold both branches until a maintainer provides live OpenShell validation or a narrower maintainer-authored fix.

recommendation.title: Use this PR after proof
recommendation.body: Keep this PR as the candidate because the source shape is complete and ask the contributor for redacted OpenShell/Gateway media-transfer proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the OpenShell workdir contract and original sandbox media mapper, making them the strongest routing owner for the candidate choice.
